fields.help_en:
The media ID or OSS file url of the input file.

1. `oss://bucket/object`

2. `http(s)://bucket.oss-[regionId].aliyuncs.com/object`

In these formats, `bucket` is the name of an OSS bucket in the same region as your project, and `object` is the file path
fields.help_zh:
输入文件信息，支持OSS地址和媒资ID两种。
OSS地址规则为：

1、oss://bucket/object

2、http(s)://bucket.oss-[regionId].aliyuncs.com/object

其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的oss bucket名称，object为文件路径
fields.name: media

fields.help_en:
The type of the input file. Valid values:

`OSS`: The input is an OSS file url.

`Media`: The input is a media ID
fields.help_zh:
输入文件类型，取值：
OSS：OSS文件地址
Media：媒资ID
fields.name: type
